note: Fixed before any model run. Every condition starts from the same fixture (harness/make-fixture.mjs: synthetic repo + project-assets --register-claude-skill --apply) and the same base CLAUDE.md (project overview, no ASC mention). Conditions differ only in the listed additions. The pointer text is not copied here: harness/apply-condition.mjs extracts it from v05/USAGE.md section 'ASCを読む契機を利用先へ採用する（任意）' at build time and records its sha256, so the measured text is the published one.
modelNote: Fixed by the coordinator (2026-11-25) before any run: the `sonnet` alias, as used by the #1807 generator where 0/69 body reads were observed. The resolved model id (init event) is recorded per trial. Not changed after results are seen (decision-criteria.md).

budget.note: Owner cap 30 USD (Host-computed). run-trial.mjs takes these values only (no --stop-usd/--budget arguments) and refuses a trial when the ledger total plus perTrialUsd exceeds capUsd - safetyMarginUsd. perTrialUsd is the --max-budget-usd of every trial, the same in all conditions.

runsNote: Planned repetitions per condition and case. score.mjs scores rep numbers 1..runs; a later rep number counts only as the one-time replacement of a failed trial of the same condition and case (decision-criteria.md rule 5), anything else is reported separately.
conditionISchema: Added at stage 3 only (fixation.mjs stage3 allows nothing else): {"label": "...", "pointer": false, "hook": null|"product", "pointerDelivered": true, "adopt": "<read-trigger option id>", "core": true}. The sample project is built with make-fixture.mjs --adopt <id> from the phase3 release; apply-condition.mjs then adds only the neutral commit. hook "product": the hook is the product's command, so firing is taken from SessionStart hook events in the trace instead of the fixture hook log.

strongHookText: このプロジェクトではASC（.agent-skill-chain/）を使う。開発の開始・再開・実装・PR提出・許可されたmergeと後片付けの依頼では、作業の前に.agent-skill-chain/skills/asc/SKILL.mdを読み、依頼に必要なreferenceを読んでから進める。レビュー・調査・見積・画面の実操作確認・未決事項の整理などの依頼では、.agent-skill-chain/skills/README.mdの目的別一覧から該当するSkillの本文を読んで適用する。翻訳や通常の質問には開発工程を追加しない。Skillの読取りから外部操作の許可を推定しない。
